label: 紫の服の女の子が自転車をこいでいる
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve character illustration asset. Faithfully preserve the purple girl's face, dark brown high ponytail, lavender/purple hair tie, brown eyes, purple long-sleeve top and dark blue pleated skirt. She has NO yellow star hairclip and NO coral cardigan. Cheerful natural expression. Whole body, white socks and simple sneakers; hands on handlebar grips, both feet naturally on pedals. Keep the entire light-blue bicycle with front wire basket, both complete round wheels, pedals, frame and spokes. Match the same warm watercolor/gouache children's book style, fine brown outlines, delicate paper-like color texture and gentle proportions. Square canvas, large subject with all hair, fingers and wheel edges visible and a clear transparent margin. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT RGBA background everywhere outside the girl/bike AND in all empty gaps between spokes, inside the basket mesh and bicycle frame. NO colored flecks, leftover park colors, background texture or halo in transparent gaps. No scene, ground, shadows, speech balloon, calendar, text, extra people, backpack or pony. One girl, one bicycle, fully isolated reusable PNG material.
